facts.text: Trackless mobile machinery (TMM) is the South African legal term for any self-propelled mining machine that does not run on rails, including haul trucks, loaders and light vehicles; crawler tracks do not exclude a machine from TMM.
facts.quote: Trackless mobile machinery (TMM) is the South African legal term for any self-propelled mining machine that does not run on rails, from haul trucks and loaders to light vehicles.

facts.text: South African regulations under the Mine Health and Safety Act covering TMM automatic braking were published in 2015 and entered into force on 21 December 2022 with no transitional period.
facts.quote: Regulations under the Mine Health and Safety Act (published 2015, in force from 21 December 2022 with no transitional period)

facts.text: South African Mine Health and Safety Act regulations require a diesel-powered TMM heading for a collision to be slowed to a safe speed and then braked automatically if the operator takes no action.
facts.quote: require that where a diesel-powered TMM is heading for a collision and the operator takes no action, the machine is slowed to a safe speed and then braked automatically

facts.text: South African Mine Health and Safety Act regulations require the TMM collision prevention system to fail to safe without human intervention.
facts.quote: and that the system fails to safe without human intervention [Chapters 2, 3]

facts.text: The booklet found no legal mandate for automatic braking on heavy mining machines other than the South African TMM mandate.
facts.quote: This is the only legal mandate for automatic braking on heavy mining machines the booklet found

facts.text: The South African legal mandate for automatic braking on heavy mining machines preceded any validation standard; industry subsequently wrote performance requirements for surface TMM collision prevention systems.
facts.quote: it came before any validation standard; industry then wrote performance requirements

facts.text: Industry wrote independent verification test specifications for surface TMM collision prevention systems in 2025 and 2026.
facts.quote: in 2025 and 2026, independent verification test specifications for surface TMM collision prevention systems [Chapters 1, 2]

facts.text: South Africa recorded nine TMM-related deaths in 2024, up from six; the passage does not specify the comparison year.
facts.quote: South Africa recorded nine TMM-related deaths in 2024, up from six [Chapter 4].

facts.text: South Africa is the booklet's main real case of a market forced to deploy collision-prevention intervention first and refine it afterward.
facts.quote: South Africa is the booklet's main real case of a market forced to deploy intervention first and refine afterward

facts.text: South Africa's TMM collision prevention verification documents are among the few existing off-road test specifications.
facts.quote: its verification documents are among the few off-road test specifications that exist [Chapters 1, 2]
